text_block_list.text:
—Summer has arrived once again this year. 
I decided to take on a part-time job on an 
uninhabited island with Ines Fujin again.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time. Alright, I'll go grab 
the gear! Let's do our best as lifeguards 
again this year!

After seeing her off as she walked away, I 
heard a familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, it's Ines's Trainer.
choice_data_list:
...Ah! Isn't that from Ines's part-time 
job...?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
'Sup! How's Ines doing lately? She's been 
cutting back on her part-time jobs, so I 
haven't seen much of her.

I tell her coworker how she's been doing 
lately. Her coworker listens with great 
interest to stories of how she acts at the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's how she is at school... At 
work, she talks about her Trainer nonstop.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
……We talk allll the time, y'know? Huh? You 
didn't know? Whaat…… Wanna hear about it?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
"I worry because she tends to put herself 
last..." and "It's just because she's so 
kind, but..."

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
"A-Also, didn't you mention getting cold 
feet after jumping into the sea and 
getting a leg cramp last year? Man, you 
must've been genuinely worried..."

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but it wasn't unpleasant at all! If 
anything—

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
"She goes, 'I can just do what I think is 
right without hesitating!'"

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
It was seriously awesome! Totally felt 
that vibe!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah! What are you two talking about~?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ines! Glad to see you're doing well～! 
We were just having an important 
conversation♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

"...I was happy to hear them praise me, 
but hearing it behind their backs like 
that left me feeling rather awkward..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Huuuh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, aren't you gonna tell me? What 
are you talking about? Tell me just a 
little bit, come on!
choice_data_list:
More importantly, about our work after 
this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you dodged the question. ...Well, I'll 
take it seriously for now, though.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Zero people in need of rescue today 
too! That's a good thing!
choice_data_list: Calling out to them really did the trick!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Frequent check-ins are key! ...Ah, maybe I 
should check in over here too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, feel like talking now?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, do you really not want to tell me 
that badly? I wonder why...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, don't tell me... were they talking 
bad about me...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I'm sorry, okay? Did I do something 
to the two of you without realizing...? 
Ugh, I'll reflect on it...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well, will you tell me?

...It's no use. I can't escape this. I 
thought it would be best for her sake, 
but... it seems better to just tell her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: D-Did you... hear that...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehh, whoaaa... No waaaay...! 
Ehhhh~~~~...!?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I really wish you'd just forget about 
it...!

Just as expected, she looks awkwardly 
flustered with a red face. I could choose 
not to mention it further, but—
choice_data_list:
...I was so happy, I could never forget 
it.

text_block_list.text:
Even if I wasn't reliable, even if I 
wasn't perfect. You acknowledged me. You 
praised me—
choice_data_list:
I think that's Ines's way of showing 
trust.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...That's just the kind of person you are, 
you know? Fufu, oh, you...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...That's not fair.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Then, I want you to remember this.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That you are— the one and only Trainer I 
put my trust in!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah-ah, my face is burning up! Now it's 
gonna be so awkward after this!
choice_data_list: Leave it to me, I've got you covered!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hehe... Look who's talking!

When I told her it was a precious 
opportunity to understand her inner 
thoughts—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, stop digging it back up! ...You 
really are a mischievous one!
